analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price (KRW 207,000) vs SMA5 (KRW 227,800) / SMA20 (KRW 263,725) / SMA50 (KRW 299,577) — below short/mid-term trends, bearish.
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 256,704) / SMA200 (KRW 191,800) — mixed long-term trend, above SMA200.
· 52-week position (48.1%) + historical mid-range price level.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.4 → 33.6) — entering oversold, downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3205.1797 → -5931.1815) — worsening, bearish trend continuation.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band KRW 205,806) + wide band width at 43.92%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 167,300) — based on Pivot S1 (KRW 155,800) and SMA200 (KRW 191,800).
· Swing resistance (KRW 209,000) — below Pivot PP (KRW 240,400) and SMA5 (KRW 227,800).
· 5-day / 20-day high/low pattern (sideways) — fails Higher Low condition, fails Lower High condition.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.35x) — momentum in price action, increased reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis (distribution phase) — maintaining wait-and-see condition due to lack of clear reversal signals.
